impact.text: it breaks core backing and yield-settlement invariants

precondition_sources.text: The Vault's 0x811 Borrow-Lend state contains a borrow liability (borrow.value) alongside supply.

intent_sources.text: When the protocol uses Borrow-Lend supply values as backing, totalBackingSigned() must account for Borrow-Lend liabilities (borrow.value) rather than treating the 0x811 state as supply-only.
The settleDailyPnL() distributable-surplus gate must prevent settlement above real distributable surplus under net backing.
Yield settlement must not move real USDC into YieldEscrow as yield when net backing has no surplus.
